name: track grant reporting deadlines and spend down with AI

parameters.content:
## 09-12-01 track grant reporting deadlines and spend down with AI

### How it works

Grant awards arrive on a webhook with funder, program, amount, term and reporting cadence. The workflow validates the record, then an AI agent turns the award terms into a reporting calendar: milestones with due dates, an internal buffer date and a compliance risk note. The award and its deadlines land in Google Sheets, the grant lead gets the calendar by email, and the team hears about it on Telegram.

A second webhook logs each draw down. The workflow matches the award, adds the spend to the running total and scores the burn rate. Past 80 percent spent, or inside 45 days of the spend by date, AI writes a finance note, Telegram and Discord alert, and the award row is updated.

Two schedules do the proactive work: a Monday sweep reminds the grant lead about every report due inside 30 days, and a monthly review posts a portfolio digest for the awards that need attention.

### Setup steps

- Create a Google Sheets workbook with five tabs: Awards, Deadlines, SpendLog, ReminderLog and Errors.
- Connect Google Sheets, Gmail, Telegram and Discord credentials, then set the alert addresses.
- Point your awards intake at the award webhook and your finance tool at the spend webhook.

### Customization

- Change the 80 percent burn alert, the 45 day spend window and the 30 day reminder window in the check nodes.
- Extend the reporting calendar agent system message to add milestone types of your own.

nodes.name: Sticky Note: Award intake and validation

parameters.content:
## Award intake and validation

New awards arrive on a webhook with funder, program, amount, term, cadence and the spend by date. Missing or invalid records never reach the register.

## AI reporting calendar

The agent reads the award terms and returns every reporting milestone, a buffer date and a compliance risk note as JSON.

## Reporting schedule delivery

Award row, deadline rows, the calendar email to the grant lead and the new award alert for the team.

## Rejected award alerts

Invalid awards go to the admin inbox, the team channel and the Errors tab with the reason, so nothing is silently dropped.

nodes.name: Sticky Note: Spend draw down watch

parameters.content:
## Spend draw down watch

Each spend entry is matched to its award, added to the running total and scored as a burn rate against the award amount.

nodes.name: Sticky Note: Burn alert and award update

parameters.content:
## Burn alert and award update

Past 80 percent spent or inside 45 days of the spend by date: AI writes the finance note, Telegram and Discord alert, and the award row is updated.

## Spend entry rejected

Bad spend payloads go to the admin inbox, the team channel and the Errors tab.

## Unknown award

Spend posted against an award id that is not in the register is flagged to the team instead of being counted.

## Weekly deadline sweep

Monday morning: every pending deadline is scored by days left. Inside 30 days AI drafts the reminder email with a data checklist, logs it and marks the deadline.

## Monthly portfolio review

First of the month: every award is checked for burn rate and spend by date. Awards that need attention go into one AI digest for the finance lead and Discord.

options.systemMessage: You are a grants compliance planner for small nonprofit teams. You receive the terms of a newly awarded grant. Plan every reporting obligation the funder will expect. Return ONLY valid JSON with these keys: milestones (array of 3 to 6 objects, each with milestone, period and due_date in YYYY-MM-DD), buffer_days (integer between 7 and 21), risk_note (under 40 words on the biggest compliance risk), first_action (one sentence on what to do first). Milestone due dates are the period end date plus the funder grace period. Cover interim progress reports, financial reports, a spend down checkpoint and the final closeout. No emojis, no markdown, JSON only.
